key_insight: OPSD-V improves few-step autoregressive video generation by self-distilling from real long-video context during training, reducing long-horizon drift without changing the fast inference path. In simple terms, it helps short-step video models stay coherent and dynamic over longer rollouts.
problem_solved: Few-step autoregressive video generators are fast, but they often accumulate errors over time and produce weaker motion as the generated video gets longer. This paper addresses long-range degradation while keeping low-latency inference intact.
method: Uses an on-policy self-distillation training scheme for post-training few-step AR video diffusion models.
Injects real long-video data as temporal context during training to better match long-horizon generation conditions.
Preserves the original few-step inference path, improving long-rollout quality without adding inference cost.
impact: This approach makes fast video generators more reliable for longer sequences, which is important for practical video creation, simulation, and content generation. Practitioners can gain better temporal consistency and motion quality without sacrificing speed.

paper_title: OPSD-V: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Post-Training Few-Step Autoregressive Video Generators
paper_authors: Hongyu Liu, Chun Wang, Feng Gao, Xuanhua He, Yue Ma
